title: Old-Time Jam @ White Dog Brewing
event_description: Weekly old-time music jam session open to all skill levels. Acoustic instruments and singers welcome in this laid-back community gathering between Labor Day and Memorial Day.
event_venue_information:
About White Dog Brewing

White Dog Brewing Company is a craft brewery in downtown Boise featuring award-winning beers and a welcoming taproom atmosphere. The brewery hosts regular live music and community events including weekly old-time music jams.

Beer & Atmosphere

White Dog features 16 house-made beers on tap plus wine - cider - and non-alcoholic options. The taproom includes a custom frost rail - patio seating - and garage doors that open to create an indoor-outdoor feel during nice weather. Food is provided by onsite food trucks.

Music & Events

The venue regularly hosts live music performances and is home to the Monday night Old-Time Jam session. The brewery provides a relaxed family-friendly environment perfect for acoustic music gatherings and community events.

title: Open Mic @ Westy's Garden Lanes
event_description: Acoustic open mic night hosted by Landonious Monk. Musicians poets and performers welcome. Returning January 2025 after seasonal break.
event_venue_information:
About Westy's Garden Lanes

Westy's Garden Lanes has been proudly serving Boise's bowling community for over 25 years. This family-friendly entertainment venue features bowling lanes - a sports bar - cafe - and hosts various community events including live music.

Venue Features

The venue offers modern computer scoring - a full-service bar - cafe dining - and a welcoming atmosphere for all ages. Westy's has ample parking and is easily accessible from the Boise area.

Entertainment

Beyond bowling - Westy's hosts regular open mic nights featuring acoustic music - poetry - and creative performances. The venue provides a casual comfortable setting for local artists to share their talents with the community.

title: Open Mic @ Boise Hive
event_description: Monthly open mic for musicians poets and creative performers. All ages welcome in this alcohol and drug-free safe space supporting mental health in the music community.
event_venue_information:
About Boise Hive

Boise Hive is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit community space dedicated to supporting musicians and the music community through affordable rehearsal space - free mental health counseling - and educational programs. Located in the historic Custom Recording & Sound building on the Boise Bench.

Mission & Services

The Hive's mission is to prevent suicide in the music community by offering counseling - education - referrals - and mental health services for musicians. The venue maintains an alcohol and drug-free all-ages environment.

Music Programs

Boise Hive hosts Open Mic Nights - Live at the Hive Saturday concerts - Jazz Jam sessions - and various music education programs. The venue features four studios/rehearsal spaces - a community room - multimedia room - recording studio - and more. Regular programs include Student Jazz - Audio Recording Classes - Veterans Sessions - and Hip Hop at The Hive.

title: Gene Harris Jazz Jam @ The Hive
event_description: Monthly jazz jam session honoring legendary pianist Gene Harris. Open to professional jazz artists college students high school players and hobbyists. Features monthly tune focus.
hosts: Boise State University Gene Harris Music Program
event_venue_information:
About Boise Hive Jazz Program

The Gene Harris Jazz Jam Nights celebrate the legacy of legendary jazz pianist Gene Harris who had a profound impact on Boise's music community through his presence at local jam sessions. These events continue that tradition of mentorship and musical growth.

Jazz at The Hive

GHJF Jam Nights are presented by Boise State University with the Boise Jazz Society as Signature Sponsor. The sessions feature a tune of the month and provide a platform for jazz musicians to connect improvise and grow their skills in an encouraging environment.

Community Impact

These jams honor Gene Harris's approach to teaching jazz - patiently accompanying students as they experience the living American art form. Each performance is unique with no two nights ever the same creating an authentic jazz experience for both performers and audiences.

About Morrison Center

The Velma V. Morrison Center for the Performing Arts is Idaho's premier performing arts venue located on the Boise State University campus. The 2037-seat main hall features world-class acoustics and a recognizable 10-story stage house visible from across Boise.

Facilities

Morrison Center includes the Main Hall (2002 capacity) - Danny Peterson Theatre (210 capacity) - and Recital Hall (200 capacity). The venue offers accessible seating - assistive listening devices - parking in the Brady Garage - and premium amenities for patrons.

Programming

The center hosts Broadway touring productions - symphony performances - dance companies - and jazz events including the Gene Harris Jazz Jam series. The venue serves as a cultural cornerstone for Boise generating significant economic impact while bringing world-class performances to Idaho.
